name: Jetoptera
description: Jetoptera is an aviation company developing a revolutionary Fluidic Propulsion System (FPS) for vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft. Their bladeless technology aims to make flight faster, quieter, and safer than traditional rotor-based systems by eliminating exposed blades. With over 155 patents, the company is transitioning from successful flying prototypes to commercial production for a projected $1T market.

founders.name: Andrei Tristan Evulet
founders.bio: Aerospace engineer and inventor with 30+ years experience. Former GE Tech Lead & Systems Engineer for the GE9X turbofan. Inventor with 100+ patents and a PhD from Rutgers University.

updates.title: Production Transition
updates.body: Successfully transitioning from flying prototypes to production-ready models with $6.1M in lifetime revenue.

name: Harmony Turbines Inc.
tagline: A smart wind turbine for your home
description: Harmony Turbines designs and manufactures innovative residential wind energy systems. Their proprietary vertical-axis wind turbine is engineered to be quiet, efficient, and aesthetically pleasing for home installations. By combining advanced aerodynamics with a unique generator system, they aim to provide reliable off-grid power to the mass market.

founders.name: Christopher Moore
founders.bio: Entrepreneur and inventor with over 25 years of experience in clean energy technologies and hardware tinkering.

updates.title: Wind Tunnel Validation
updates.body: Completed full-scale wind-tunnel testing validating the proprietary generator and turbine design.

name: Dividends
tagline: AI-powered investing that pays you monthly (backed by real businesses)
description: Dividends is a financial technology platform that uses AI to curate alternative investment opportunities for retail users. The platform focuses on acquiring and managing cash-flowing online businesses to distribute monthly returns to investors. By lowering the barrier to entry for business acquisitions, they aim to capture a share of the $5T alternative investment market.

founders.name: Michael Swigunski
founders.bio: Bestselling author and entrepreneur with over $120M in online business deal experience. Former early employee at Empire Flippers.

updates.title: Wefunder Launch
updates.body: Officially launched the community round to scale AI-driven alternative asset acquisitions.

name: TibaRay, Inc.
tagline: Patented radiotherapy technology designed to help cure cancer in a FLASH™
description: TibaRay is a medical technology company developing PHASER, a next-generation radiotherapy system. Their technology delivers ultra-high dose-rate radiation (FLASH) which is designed to kill tumor cells while sparing healthy tissue. The company is a spin-off from Stanford University and SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory research.

founders.name: Thinh Tran
founders.bio: Stanford graduate and repeat founder. Previously founded Sigma Designs and grew it to a NASDAQ listing with a $2B market cap.

updates.title: IP Expansion
updates.body: Expanded portfolio to 20+ patents covering the PHASER and FLASH radiotherapy systems.

highlights: 20+ patents in medical imaging and therapy
Led by former $2B market cap CEO

name: p!ng
tagline: Fast Drive-Thru Coffee, Powered by Robots
description: p!ng is modernizing the drive-thru experience by integrating robotics and automation into coffee retail. Their system is designed to provide high-quality beverages at significantly higher speeds than traditional human-operated cafes. By reducing footprint and labor costs, p!ng aims to scale rapidly across high-traffic urban and suburban corridors.

founders.name: Jane Lo
founders.bio: Analytics expert and former advisor to Fortune 500 executives. Brand marketer with experience launching products at SharkNinja.

updates.title: Retention Success
updates.body: Early data indicates a 67% customer return rate, demonstrating strong product-market fit.
